body:
#567 bounded diagnostic readback. The unchanged Windows Edge cold offline Loops test at `154e78d54ee485330816d606032280de44d6e891` passed once in a fresh disposable context with zero retries. The earlier command selected no tests and is retained separately. A distinct observer run captured the old document's offline event, cold `navigator.onLine=false`, service worker control, real offline requests, “You are offline” without the API-unreachable banner, and same-URL recovery. An independent API-only control in #561 kept the browser online.

The prior instrumented failure and both exact banner assertions are retained. This is a bounded non-reproduction. The cause is unresolved and there is no code, timeout, retry or diagnostic change to dispatch on this evidence. Keep the item open for a controlled recurrence.

The public Browser log for [PR #582 CI run 45571609471](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/45571609471/job/139059364536) reports another failure of the unresolved-voice, other-tab PWA update test at `e2e/pwa.spec.ts:536`. Totals were 493 passed, one failed and one declared live-provider skip, with zero retries. The other six CI lanes passed; the overall run remains failed.

This is being tracked against the existing #555 observation rather than opening a duplicate. The existing #567 admission and implementation ownership remain unchanged. No root cause or product fix is claimed, and no competing implementation has been started.
